name: Flat Highlight
summary: Bright product promos: flat colour scenes, words that jump in, one key word on a brand-colour plate, one UI card per scene.
best_for: SaaS and web tools with a 3–4 step flow
prompt: Make a 25-second Flat Highlight promo for our tool at example.com/converter. Steps: drop a file, pick a format, download.

name: Dark Pixel
summary: Dark tech promos with one accent colour, a pixel mascot, a browser where a cursor types and clicks, and pixel-stripe shutters.
best_for: Developer and AI tools that prove themselves on screen
prompt: Make a Dark Pixel promo for our app at example.com: paste a link, it analyses the page, you get a report.

name: Film Slice 3D
summary: One 3D metaphor for video tools: a long video as a film strip, a piece lifts off and lands as a finished clip.
best_for: Video cutting, clipping and repurposing tools
prompt: Make a Film Slice video for our clipping tool: one long podcast becomes three clips.

name: Pixel Captions
summary: Vertical shorts where the captions are the hero: words light up as they are said, one word on a plate, a pixel scene above.
best_for: Reels, Shorts and TikTok, with or without a voiceover
prompt: Make a 20-second vertical Pixel Captions short about our new feature, using this voiceover.

name: HUD Dashboard
summary: A no-cut control panel: a turning point sphere lights up, counters tick, a log grows. A system at work in 20 seconds.
best_for: Pipelines, batch tools and automations that process many items
prompt: Make a HUD Dashboard video showing our tool processing 8 files in a row, ending on our URL.

name: Card Carousel 3D
summary: Many cards in 3D layouts that flow into each other: a turning ring, an arc, a focus, a fan. For galleries and catalogues.
prompt: Make a Card Carousel video of our 16 templates, ending with a focus on the most popular one.

name: Mono Grid
summary: A black-and-white editorial film in four panels. Each panel has its own rhythm, and the panels change one by one.
best_for: Calm premium teasers and brand films
prompt: Make a 20-second Mono Grid teaser for our recorder app, black and white, our colour only on the last button.

name: Paper Collage
summary: Explainers that look made by hand: torn paper on dark cardboard, cut-out words, typewriter labels and a red thread.
best_for: Explainers, how-it-works and blog to video
prompt: Make a 30-second Paper Collage explainer of this blog post, with the key number as a big cut-out.

name: Mascot Pastel
summary: Friendly promos with a character: pastel scenes that flow into each other, a serif accent word, a phone with the live product.
best_for: Consumer and creator apps, playful launches
prompt: Make a Mascot Pastel promo for our mobile app with our mascot: sign up, create, share.

name: Split Compare
summary: Before and after on one frame: a compare slider, BEFORE and AFTER tags, a frame that reshapes, scene changes by a seam.
best_for: Editing tools, converters, redesigns and v1 vs v2
prompt: Make a Split Compare video: our raw interview on the left, the edited version with captions on the right.
